<function name="GetSize" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns the size of the panel.

If you require both the panel's position and size, consider using <page>Panel:GetBounds</page> instead.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The panel's width. (<page>Panel:GetWide</page>)</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number">The panel's height (<page>Panel:GetTall</page>)</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
